sp_south_gate_scout: Deathguard Lyle. This is the north gate of the south woods; the Rear Guard's country is behind you. Follow the road south and you come to Valgan's Field, where the March keeps its post. Past that, the pines belong to whatever has the most teeth.
sp_buckle_goodwife: Merriam. Goodwife, they used to say. This is Bucklebree Farm, the north-west corner. The hogs went first. Then the quilts. I have lost track of what is left to lose, but something still comes down from the trees at night to look for it.
sp_buckle_farmer: Bucklebree. Three generations on this farm and I am the first to work it dead. I would say the yield has not changed, and I would be lying to make a joke. Olivia's Pond is south of my fence, and I do not water the stock there any more.
sp_south_hunter: I hunt for the March. My trap line runs east from here toward the Decrepit Ferry. Even death did not stop me putting meat on a table, though nobody at the table needs it. Old habits. The carrion birds have learned the line better than I have.
pt_spsouth_essence: Ysolde. Tinker Ysolde here, so that nobody sends you to the smith in the Sepulcher by mistake. I teach engineering on the west side of Valgan's Field. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and a steady hand. The mine at Deep Elem has the first two, if you can get in.
pt_spsouth_hide: Rothgar, tanner. I work east of the post, on the Ferry road, where the hunters pass. Hide, leather, cloth, and the meat off the same carcass - pay once and I teach the lot. There is more wolf in these woods than there should be. I do not ask why. I just skin it.
sp_ferryman: Gael, ferryman. This is the Decrepit Ferry, the north-east shore, and that is Fenris Isle out on the lake. The boat goes where the lake lets it. Pay up front. The lake keeps a tally, and I would rather it was your name on it than mine.
sp_ferry_dockhand: Pim. I work the dock for Gael. Crates wash up at all hours from the Fenris side. Half of them are empty. The other half I do not open, and I stack those further from where I sleep.
pt_spsouth_herbs: Harken, apothecary. I teach herbs at Valgan's Field, north side of the post. Every weed is a medicine to someone. In the south woods you want to know which, because the blight has changed a few of them and not for the better.
sp_south_march_sergeant: Sergeant Dallow. This is Valgan's Field, and the post is the March - we exist to keep the road open from the north gate down to Ambermill and Pyrewood. Lately that is a full-time fight, and I have fewer soldiers than I have roads.
ct_spsouth: Osric. I train every discipline for the March, here at Valgan's Field. The sergeant sends me soldiers who have learned to fight one thing, and Silverpine has more than one thing in it. Show me where you are, and bring coin.
sp_south_flight_master: Veshka, bat handler. The roost is at Valgan's Field, beside the sergeant's post. Forest roads are for the careless. Hold the straps and pick a roost - the Sepulcher is the short hop, the Undercity the long one.
pt_spsouth_forge: Verity. Mining and smithing, both halves. I teach at Valgan's Field, by the sawmill - and the sawmill is all we have; there is no forge south of Brill. Deep Elem Mine is west of here if you want ore, and so do the kobolds.
sp_valgan_surgeon: Ashe, field surgeon to the March. My table is in the middle of the post, where they can carry them in from any side. I stitch what is torn and I remove what has gone off. The two jobs overlap more than you would like. Bites, mostly, this year. Large ones.
sp_pond_marshwalker: Thorne, marshwalker. That is Olivia's Pond behind me, on the west side of the woods, south of the Bucklebree fence. It was a pretty spot once. Now the water moves when nothing is stirring it, and I have started marking the stones to prove it.
pt_spsouth_wood: Lenore, woodwright. I teach at the south-west corner of Valgan's Field. Fell it, saw it, make something of it. The sawmill is across the post, on the east side. Silverpine was named for its timber, and the timber is the one thing here that has not turned.
sp_amber_millwright: Haskell, millwright. This is Ambermill, the east side of the woods. It ran on Dalaran gold and Dalaran sawdust. Now it runs on ghosts and spite, and the mages who stayed have gone into the tower through that gate of theirs and not come out.
sp_amber_magister: Magister Orsolo. I am what is left of Ambermill's faculty that will still talk to visitors. The waygate is south-east of the mill, below the tower. It was a mill-lift once. Then someone aimed it somewhere worse.
sp_pyre_hearthwarden: Brand, hearthwarden of Pyrewood Village. You are in the middle of the south woods; Ambermill is east of here and the Greymane Wall is south. Pyrewood burned for a reason. Whatever rose out of the ashes did not read the reasons.
sp_elem_foreman: Hobart. I was overseer of Deep Elem Mine, and that is its mouth, here on the west edge of the woods. Deep Elem paid well, until it did not. The kobolds stayed. So did I. Neither of us got a pension.
sp_peril_packbreaker: Rynn. Packbreaker - I made the title up, and I intend to earn it. This is Beren's Peril, in the south, and the keep on the hill south-west of us is Shadowfang. A pack leader is a promise to the pack. I intend to break a few promises.
sp_talon_trapper: Hask, trapper. Berard's Talon, they call this hill - the south-west corner, under Shadowfang Keep. Traps still work on the dead. They only have to be bigger. What comes down from the keep at night, I have not built one big enough for yet.
sp_wall_corporal: Corporal Teague. That is the Greymane Wall, the south-east end of Silverpine, and Gilneas is behind it. It has been shut since the night the gate fell. We do not open it. We do not let anything open it. I write that in the log every night.
sp_sfk_gatekeeper: Marl, gatekeeper. Behind that portcullis is Shadowfang Keep, at the south-west end of the woods. Nobody goes through and nobody comes out, and I have stood here long enough to be glad of both. If you hear howling, it is the draught. Say it is the draught.
